question:
The following bar chart shows the revenue (in thousand rupees) generated from the sale of 5 different objects, O1 to O5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6836d2e6b1241b9e78a818f039ef265d6ff1f88160a55ae5298ac071c7ab761d.png] 

The following bar chart shows the profit percentage gained through the sales of these 5 objects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cf32db41b26a7839d05c624686d9ae02559191188cbdff7187ac730f5b0fcd3.png] 

What is the cost incurred in the procurement and sale of O1?
solution:
**Given:**

Bar charts showing the revenue (in thousand rupees) generated and profit earned from the sale of 5 different objects is given.

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = frac{{revenue - cost}}{{cost}}×100&l
